name: Atlantic Central Enterprise Ltd.
summary: Operating through its subsidiary, Vista Technologies, Inc., Atlantic Central Enterprise Ltd. (ACE) provides specialized facilities and services for laser vision correction treatments, including photorefractive keratectomy (PRK), to the medical sector. The company primarily conducts its business in the United States and various countries in Western Europe. Incorporated in 1996, ACE has its corporate headquarters located in Hamilton, Bermuda. The entity previously traded under the name Bamburgh Limited before officially rebranding as Atlantic Central Enterprise Ltd. in April of the same year.
